EXPORT-REG WAV is clipped by design of the test mix (3 demo sources). The app alert reads +1.7 dBFS, 470 samples limited. C's wav.cjs counts 486 samples >= 0.9999, a different threshold. This is the existing overload feature, not a regression.

In ENTER-ADD-REG the Enter keydown on the library row did not reach the window bubble listener: the row stops propagation. This existed before round 98 and matches round 96. The clip add and Undo work.

The run98 recorder (addInitScript) bubble listener runs before the app's window keydown handler, so its defaultPrevented for app-global keys (Space) is read too early. For the Export guard (a React onKeyDown) it is valid: true on the repeats. The Space evidence uses a late listener (space98).
